blockdesc-coeur-*: The heart of a storage network. Everything linked to it by conduits shares the memory cylinders of the bays. One core per network.
blockdesc-baie-*: Holds up to 8 memory cylinders. Right-click to open.
blockdesc-terminal-*: Browse the whole network: search, sort, deposit and withdraw. With a linked workshop: crafting grid and recipes.
blockdesc-stabilisateur-*: Burns temporal gears to slow spoilage in the network, or freeze it in stasis cylinders. Right-click to open.
blockdesc-conduit-*: Links network blocks to the temporal core.
itemdesc-cylindre-*: Goes in a cylinder bay. Its contents follow it, even in your inventory or another bay.
curveostockage:erreur-sans-coeur: No temporal core linked to this terminal.
curveostockage:erreur-plusieurs-coeurs: Several cores on the same network: keep only one.
curveostockage:erreur-sans-cylindre: No memory cylinder in the network's bays.
curveostockage:refus-chaud: Too hot for a memory cylinder: let it cool down.
curveostockage:refus-cylindre: A cylinder cannot be stored inside another cylinder.
curveostockage:refus-plein: The network is full (item count or item types).
curveostockage:cyl-desc-refrigere: Refrigerated: food spoils half as fast.
curveostockage:cyl-desc-stase: Stasis: with a stabilizer in stasis mode, nothing spoils here. Otherwise it chills like a refrigerated cylinder.
blockdesc-emetteur-*: Linked to the network, it gives storage tablets access within 128 blocks. Right-click with a tablet: link it.
blockdesc-ancre-*: Burns temporal gears to keep its network's chunks loaded, even with no player around. Right-click to open. One active anchor per player.
itemdesc-tablette: Right-click a temporal emitter to link it, then right-click elsewhere to open the network remotely.
curveostockage:tablette-non-reliee: This tablet isn't linked: right-click a temporal emitter.
curveostockage:tablette-endormi: Network asleep: nobody nearby and no fuelled temporal anchor.
curveostockage:tablette-emetteur-absent: The emitter linked to this tablet is gone.
curveostockage:tablette-interdit: You don't have access to this network.
curveostockage:ancre-deja: You already have an active temporal anchor (at {0}, {1}, {2}).
curveostockage:ancre-info-inactive: Inactive: no chunk is kept loaded.
curveostockage:ancre-info-active: Keeps {0} chunk column(s) loaded · runs for about {1} days (less during a storm)
curveostockage:ancre-info-limitee: Network too spread out: only the {0} closest columns are kept.
curveostockage:baie-aide: Click a slot to insert or remove a cylinder: it keeps its contents, even in another bay.
curveostockage:desc-mode-0: No slowdown; refrigerated and stasis cylinders: ×0.5.
curveostockage:desc-mode-1: Spoilage halved across the network (quartered in refrigerated and stasis cylinders).
curveostockage:desc-mode-2: Spoilage divided by 10 across the network (by 20 in refrigerated cylinders).
curveostockage:desc-mode-3: Nothing spoils in stasis cylinders; ×0.1 elsewhere (×0.05 when refrigerated).
curveostockage:legende-limitee: Network too spread out: closest first.
curveostockage:journal-vide: No activity in the last 24 h
curveostockage:proprio-regle: Owner: {0} · one active anchor per player
curveostockage:infobulle-aide: Click: a stack · Right click: half · Shift: inventory · Middle: pin
blockdesc-atelier-*: Linked to the network, adds a crafting grid to terminals and tablets. After each craft, the grid refills from the network.
curveostockage:atelier-recette-inconnue: Recipe not found on the server.
curveostockage:atelier-grille-pleine: The grid could not be cleared (network full?).
curveostockage:atelier-manque: Some ingredients are missing from the network.
curveostockage:aide-epingles-vide: Middle-click an item to pin it here
blockdesc-busimport-*: Pulls the contents of the container its head faces into the network (the output, for a machine). Also takes whatever a hopper or chute pushes into it. Optional filter.
blockdesc-busexport-*: Keeps the chosen amount of each filtered item in the container its head faces, taken from the network. Machines place the item themselves (fuel, input…).
blockdesc-busstockage-*: Adds the chest, crate or shelf its head faces to the network: its contents show up in terminals and are used like the cylinders' contents.
curveostockage:note-entree: Put items here, or attach a hopper or chute to the bus: everything goes into the network.
curveostockage:note-import: Empty filter: everything is pulled. Whitelist: only these items. Blacklist: everything but them.
curveostockage:note-export: Each slot sets an item and the amount to keep in the target block; the bus tops it up from the network.
curveostockage:note-stockage: The filter picks what the network may insert here. As a whitelist, this storage is filled before the cylinders.
curveostockage:aide-filtre-pile: item and amount of the held stack
curveostockage:bus-sans-cible: No container in front of the bus head.
curveostockage:bus-interdit: Protected container: whoever placed the bus has no access to it.
curveostockage:bus-incompatible: This block is not a storage (chest, crate, shelf…).
curveostockage:cyl-desactive: Disabled on this server: works like a regular cylinder.
blockdesc-automate-*: Crafts the recipes of the punch cards placed in it on its own, using the network's contents: to keep a stock or on order from a terminal. A mechanical axle above or below speeds it up.
itemdesc-carte-*: Punched in the workshop's recipe browser, then placed in a clockwork automaton.
curveostockage:carte-vierge-info: Pick a recipe in the workshop's recipe browser and click “Punch a card”.
curveostockage:carte-garder: Keeps {0} in stock in the network
curveostockage:carte-manque: You need a blank card (in your inventory or the network).
curveostockage:carte-classe: This recipe is class-restricted: an automaton cannot make it.
curveostockage:carte-perforee-ok: Punch card added to your inventory.
curveostockage:automate-manque: An order is waiting for an ingredient.
curveostockage:automate-aide: − / +: amount to keep in the network (Shift ×10, Ctrl ×64). At 0, the card is only used for orders placed from a terminal (Ctrl+Click).
curveostockage:commande-sans-carte: No automaton in the network has a card for this item.
curveostockage:ancre-info-libre: Keeps {0} chunk column(s) loaded, no fuel needed
curveostockage:commande-file-pleine: The network's crafting queue is full.
